'''Debin Karre''' was a modest-seeming, middle-aged [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had wanted to join the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as a young man, but a childhood accident left him with a decided limp. Despite this setback, Karre believed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]] was the best government for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and joined the Empire as an [[Imperial morale officer]].
